dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Let's get to the serious topic.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: You've done me a big favor the past few days. I really don't know how I can repay you.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Considering our amiable collaboration so far, it wouldn't be enough to pay you with Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Be serious! Am I so vulgar as to humiliate you with mere gold?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Wouldn't that be a sheer insult to you?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Here, take this letter. If you ever run into any trouble or need some help in your future journey in Sumeru, bring it to the House of Purbiruni.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: We'll spare no effort in helping you.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: "Connections are far more precious than gold."

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: This Sumeru saying rings quite true.
